answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 19795 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to stand alone in the jamaath row when the row in front is complete, or should I pull another person from the preceeding row in order to avoid standing alone in the row. Question: Assalaamualaikum Is it permissible to stand alone in the jamaath row when the row in front is complete, or should I pull another person from the preceeding row in order to avoid standing alone in the row. Answer ID: 19795 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 267/267/M=1431) It is makrooh to stand alone behind row. If the front row is complete and no one is expected to come, you can take back such a person from the front row who is aware of masayil and will possibly not spoil his salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
